plugin.name: assign_texture
plugin.title: Assign texture
plugin.description: Assign a texture to cube faces. Works on a single cube, several cubes, or a whole group (cubes are collected recursively). Omit `faces` to assign all six faces.

references.description: Several nodes (groups are expanded to their cubes)

faces.description: Faces to affect; omit for all six faces

plugin.name: auto_uv
plugin.title: Auto UV
plugin.description: Recompute automatic UVs for one or more cubes with `Cube.mapAutoUV()`, which is exactly what the outliner auto-UV button calls. Use after resizing or repositioning cubes so their texture regions stay in sync.

references.description: Several nodes; groups are expanded recursively

plugin.name: bulk_create_cubes
plugin.title: Create many cubes
plugin.description: Create many cubes in a single undo step. This is the primary construction tool: a detailed Minecraft creature is built from one or a few calls like this rather than dozens of single-cube calls. Every cube may also be placed under a group by name via its `parent` field.

from.description: Minimum corner in Blockbench units (three numbers: [x, y, z])

to.description: Maximum corner in Blockbench units (three numbers: [x, y, z])

origin.description: Pivot point; defaults to the centre of the cube (three numbers: [x, y, z])

rotation.description: Euler rotation in degrees (three numbers: [x, y, z])

uv_offset.description: Box UV offset on the texture (two numbers: [u, v])

autouv.description: Auto UV mode: 0 off, 1 auto, 2 relative

box_uv.description: Use box UV instead of per-face UV

texture.description: Texture uuid or name to assign to every face; use null to clear

parent.description: Name or uuid of the group to place this cube under
Default parent group name/uuid applied to cubes that do not specify one

plugin.name: bulk_create_keyframes
plugin.title: Create many keyframes
plugin.description: Create many keyframes across any number of bones in one call and one undo step. This is how a walk cycle or attack animation should be authored: describe every pose in a single call instead of one keyframe at a time.

animation.description: Animation name (defaults to the active animation)

set_length.description: Extend the animation length to fit the last keyframe

plugin.name: checkpoint
plugin.title: Create checkpoint
plugin.description: Record a restorable point in the project history. It stores both the undo stack position and a full compiled snapshot, so it can be restored either by rewinding undo (instant) or by reloading the snapshot. Always available even where no native checkpoint API exists, because Blockbench has none.

include_snapshot.description: Also store a full project snapshot on disk

plugin.name: create_animation
plugin.title: Create animation
plugin.description: Create a new empty animation. `loop` is once / loop / hold. Length is in the format's native time unit (seconds for Bedrock and Java). Pass `select: true` to make it the active animation, which is required before its keyframes are shown in the timeline.

snapping.description: Snap rate in keyframes per second (1-120)

plugin.name: create_bone
plugin.title: Create bone
plugin.description: Create a bone. In Blockbench a bone IS a group inside a format with `bone_rig` enabled, so this validates that the active format is a rig format and otherwise fails with a clear message.

name.description: Bone name (Minecraft bone names must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$)

origin.description: Bone pivot in Blockbench units, i.e. where it rotates from (three numbers: [x, y, z])

rotation.description: Rest rotation in degrees (three numbers: [x, y, z])

parent.description: Parent group; omit to place at the outliner root.

plugin.name: create_cube
plugin.title: Create cube
plugin.description: Create a single cube. Coordinates are Blockbench units where 16 units = 1 Minecraft block and the origin sits at the bottom centre of the model. Prefer bulk_create_cubes when building more than a couple of cubes.

from.description: Minimum corner in Blockbench units (three numbers: [x, y, z])

to.description: Maximum corner in Blockbench units (three numbers: [x, y, z])

origin.description: Pivot point; defaults to the centre of the cube (three numbers: [x, y, z])

rotation.description: Euler rotation in degrees (three numbers: [x, y, z])

uv_offset.description: Box UV offset on the texture (two numbers: [u, v])

autouv.description: Auto UV mode: 0 off, 1 auto, 2 relative

box_uv.description: Use box UV instead of per-face UV

texture.description: Texture uuid or name to assign to every face; use null to clear

plugin.name: create_group
plugin.title: Create group
plugin.description: Create an outliner group (bone in rig formats). Groups own a pivot (`origin`) and rotation and are the only way to build an animatable hierarchy. Optionally nest it under an existing group.

origin.description: Pivot point in Blockbench units (three numbers: [x, y, z])

rotation.description: Euler rotation in degrees (three numbers: [x, y, z])

parent.description: Parent group; omit to place at the outliner root.

plugin.name: create_keyframe
plugin.title: Create keyframe
plugin.description: Create one keyframe on a bone. `time` is in the animation's native unit (seconds). For rotation and position x/y/z are degrees and Blockbench units; for scale they are multipliers (1 = unchanged). The keyframe is snapped and any previous keyframe at the same time on the same channel is replaced, exactly like the UI.

animation.description: Animation name (defaults to the active animation)

node.description: Bone/group name or uuid this keyframe animates

plugin.name: create_locator
plugin.title: Create locator
plugin.description: Create a locator (an empty positioned point used by Bedrock animation effects). Requires a format with locator support.

position.description: Position in Blockbench units (three numbers: [x, y, z])

parent.description: Parent group; omit to place at the outliner root.

plugin.name: create_texture
plugin.title: Create texture
plugin.description: Create a new texture in the project, either from a base64 PNG data URL or as a solid colour of the given size. Returns the texture uuid which other tools use to assign it to cube faces.

width.description: Width in pixels (ignored when data_url is given)

height.description: Height in pixels (ignored when data_url is given)

fill_color.description: Colour used to fill a blank texture, e.g. "#4a7a3a"

plugin.name: delete_animation
plugin.title: Delete animation
plugin.description: Permanently delete an animation and all of its keyframes.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm deletion

plugin.name: delete_keyframe
plugin.title: Delete keyframe
plugin.description: Delete a keyframe by bone + channel + time, or clear every keyframe of a bone/channel in a time range.

animation.description: Animation name (defaults to the active animation)

time.description: Time of the keyframe to delete

from_time.description: Delete keyframes at or after this time

to_time.description: Delete keyframes at or before this time

delete_all.description: Delete every keyframe on that bone/channel

plugin.name: delete_node
plugin.title: Delete node
plugin.description: Delete one or more outliner nodes. Deleting a group also deletes its children unless `keep_children` is true, in which case they are re-parented to the group parent.

reference.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

items.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

keep_children.description: Re-parent children instead of deleting them

plugin.name: delete_texture
plugin.title: Delete texture
plugin.description: Remove a texture from the project. Cube faces that referenced it are cleared.

plugin.name: duplicate_animation
plugin.title: Duplicate animation
plugin.description: Copy an existing animation, including all keyframes and animators, under a new name. The preferred way to build a family of animations (idle, walk, run) from one base pose set.

plugin.name: duplicate_array
plugin.title: Duplicate array
plugin.description: Duplicate a node `count` times applying a fixed translation (and optional rotation step) between copies. This is the correct way to build symmetric or repeated anatomy: two legs, a row of teeth, spines along the back. Each copy is placed under the same parent as the source.

reference.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

offset.description: Translation applied between successive copies (three numbers: [x, y, z])

rotation_step.description: Rotation added to each successive copy, in degrees (three numbers: [x, y, z])

name_pattern.description: Name template where {i} is replaced by the copy index

include_first.description: Also move the original node by offset * 0, i.e. keep it as copy 0 (default true)

plugin.name: focus_viewport
plugin.title: Focus viewport
plugin.description: Move the viewport camera to a named angle preset (initial, north, south, east, west, top, bottom, isometric_right, isometric_left, true_isometric_right, true_isometric_left). Purely visual; does not modify the model.

plugin.name: get_live_viewport
plugin.title: Get live viewport
plugin.description: Crop exactly what the user currently sees in their viewport, including their camera angle and framing. Useful for answering "does this look right from where I am looking".

plugin.name: get_model_snapshot
plugin.title: Get model snapshot
plugin.description: Capture several camera angles of the model in one call — the main way to actually look at what was built. Defaults to the current view plus front, side, top and both isometric angles. Returns one PNG per angle so the caller can composite them.

plugin.name: get_project_history
plugin.title: Get project history
plugin.description: Return the undo stack size and position plus the list of recent edits with labels and timestamps.

plugin.name: get_texture_image
plugin.title: Get texture image
plugin.description: Return the actual pixels of a texture as a base64 PNG data URL so they can be looked at. Prefer this over get_texture_view when you want the texture itself rather than the editor around it.

texture.description: Texture name or uuid (defaults to the selected texture)

plugin.name: get_texture_view
plugin.title: Get texture view
plugin.description: Capture the 2D texture editor canvas, including the UV overlay, so you can see how faces are laid out over the texture as well as the texture itself.

plugin.name: get_uv_view
plugin.title: Get UV view
plugin.description: Capture the UV editor so you can judge whether face UVs are packed sensibly, mirrored correctly and free of overlaps.

plugin.name: get_viewport_image
plugin.title: Get viewport image
plugin.description: Render the model to a PNG and return it as a data URL. `angle` selects the camera: "view" keeps the user's current angle, otherwise use a preset id (north/south/east/west/top/bottom/isometric_right/isometric_left/isometric/initial). The capture happens offscreen, so it does not move the user's viewport.
plugin.returns: ViewportImage { angle, data_url, width, height, bytes }

plugin.name: import_texture
plugin.title: Import texture
plugin.description: Add a texture to the project from a base64 PNG data URL (typically generated by the bridge and stored in the project). Optionally assigns it to every face of the given cubes right away.

assign_to.description: Nodes whose cube faces should receive this texture

faces.description: Faces to affect; omit for all six faces

plugin.name: inspect_animation
plugin.title: Inspect animation
plugin.description: One animation in full: its animators and, for each animator and channel, the keyframes with time, interpolation and data point values.
plugin.returns: { animation, animators: [{ node, channels: { channel: KeyframeSummary[] } }] }

plugin.name: inspect_animations
plugin.title: Inspect animations
plugin.description: Every animation in the project with its length, loop mode, snapping, marker names, animator count and total keyframe count.

plugin.name: inspect_hierarchy
plugin.title: Inspect hierarchy
plugin.description: The outliner tree: groups and their children with pivots, rotations, visibility and, for cubes, from/to/size. Use `max_depth` to keep the payload small and `root` to inspect only a subtree.

root.description: Reference to an outliner node. Supply uuid or name; omit both to use the current selection.

name.description: Node name (case insensitive; must be unique)

plugin.name: inspect_model
plugin.title: Inspect model
plugin.description: Model level geometry statistics: total cubes, bounding box and overall size in Blockbench units, combined volume, per-axis histogram of element sizes, hidden and locked element counts, and how many cubes still have no texture assigned.

include_cubes.description: Include the full per-cube list (can be large)

plugin.name: inspect_node
plugin.title: Inspect node
plugin.description: Everything about a single node: full geometry, pivot, rotation, UV settings, per-face texture/UV/cullface, and its direct children.

reference.description: Reference to an outliner node. Supply uuid or name; omit both to use the current selection.

name.description: Node name (case insensitive; must be unique)

plugin.name: inspect_project
plugin.title: Inspect project
plugin.description: Full project header: Blockbench version, project name and path, active model format and its capabilities (bone rig, box UV, animation mode, rotation limit), target version, resolution, saved state and element/group/texture/animation counts.

plugin.name: inspect_selection
plugin.title: Inspect selection
plugin.description: What the user currently has selected: groups, elements, textures, animation, keyframes and active mode.

plugin.name: inspect_textures
plugin.title: Inspect textures
plugin.description: Every texture in the project: name, pixel dimensions, file path, whether it is embedded, how its source is stored (data URL, path or empty), render mode and selection.

plugin.name: inspect_uv
plugin.title: Inspect UV
plugin.description: UV mapping of one or more cubes: per-face UV rectangles, rotation, assigned texture, cullface; plus the cube-level uv_offset, autouv mode and box_uv flag. Also reports whether every UV rectangle fits inside the texture.

reference.description: Reference to an outliner node. Supply uuid or name; omit both to use the current selection.

name.description: Node name (case insensitive; must be unique)

include_all_cubes.description: Inspect every cube instead of a single node

plugin.name: inspect_viewport
plugin.title: Inspect viewport
plugin.description: Viewport state: active preview, camera position and target, orthographic zoom, view mode, shading, display slot and how many elements are currently visible versus hidden. Use get_viewport_image afterwards for actual pixels.

plugin.name: list_capabilities
plugin.title: List capabilities
plugin.description: Report the running Blockbench build: version, platform, active format, which APIs were verified to exist, installed plugins, known limitations and the full list of real event names. Call this first when you need to know what the environment can do.

plugin.name: list_checkpoints
plugin.title: List checkpoints
plugin.description: List every checkpoint recorded in this session with its label, time and undo position.

plugin.name: mark_project_saved
plugin.title: Mark project saved
plugin.description: Clear the unsaved-changes marker in Blockbench after the bridge has written the file to disk.

save_path.description: Absolute path the project was written to

plugin.name: modify_animation
plugin.title: Modify animation
plugin.description: Rename an animation or change its length, loop mode and snapping rate.

snapping.description: Snap rate in keyframes per second

plugin.name: modify_cube
plugin.title: Modify cube
plugin.description: Change an existing cube: resize (from/to), move/rotate via origin and rotation, inflate, mirror UV, assign a texture to every face, toggle auto UV. Returns the verified resulting geometry.

reference.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

from.description: Minimum corner in Blockbench units (three numbers: [x, y, z])

to.description: Maximum corner in Blockbench units (three numbers: [x, y, z])

origin.description: Pivot point; defaults to the centre of the cube (three numbers: [x, y, z])

rotation.description: Euler rotation in degrees (three numbers: [x, y, z])

uv_offset.description: Box UV offset on the texture (two numbers: [u, v])

autouv.description: Auto UV mode: 0 off, 1 auto, 2 relative

box_uv.description: Use box UV instead of per-face UV

texture.description: Texture uuid or name to assign to every face; use null to clear

plugin.name: modify_keyframe
plugin.title: Modify keyframe
plugin.description: Change an existing keyframe: move it in time or change its x/y/z values and interpolation. The keyframe is located by bone + channel + time (within half a snapping step).

animation.description: Animation name (defaults to the active animation)

time.description: Time of the keyframe to change

plugin.name: modify_node
plugin.title: Modify node
plugin.description: Rename, move, rotate or hide any node (cube, group, locator). For cubes you can also change inflate, UV settings and face textures. Only the fields you pass are touched.

reference.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

references.description: Apply the same change to several nodes

items.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

from.description: Minimum corner in Blockbench units (three numbers: [x, y, z])

to.description: Maximum corner in Blockbench units (three numbers: [x, y, z])

origin.description: Pivot point; defaults to the centre of the cube (three numbers: [x, y, z])

rotation.description: Euler rotation in degrees (three numbers: [x, y, z])

uv_offset.description: Box UV offset on the texture (two numbers: [u, v])

autouv.description: Auto UV mode: 0 off, 1 auto, 2 relative

box_uv.description: Use box UV instead of per-face UV

texture.description: Texture uuid or name to assign to every face; use null to clear

plugin.name: new_project
plugin.title: New project
plugin.description: Start a fresh empty project in the given model format. Use `free` for a generic project with no format restrictions, or a real format id such as `bedrock_entity`, `java_block`, `modded_entity` or `skin`.

plugin.name: offset_nodes
plugin.title: Offset nodes
plugin.description: Translate one or more nodes by a delta, moving geometry and pivot together. `space` chooses whether the delta is applied to the node pivot (`origin`, default) or to the cube volume only.

reference.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

items.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

delta.description: Translation delta in Blockbench units (three numbers: [x, y, z])

plugin.name: open_project
plugin.title: Open project
plugin.description: Replace the current project with a .bbmodel document previously read by the bridge. Pass the parsed JSON document, not a path.

path.description: Optional path used for naming and for relative texture paths

merge.description: Merge into the current project instead of replacing it

plugin.name: paint_texture
plugin.title: Paint texture
plugin.description: Draw pixels onto a texture. Operations are applied in order and may include fill, rect, outline, pixel (or a list of pixels), line, gradient_v, shade_rect (darken/lighten an existing region: Minecraft shading), copy_region, mirror_region and noise. Coordinates are pixels with (0,0) at the top left. Use this to author real textures rather than flat fills.

texture.description: Texture name or uuid (defaults to the selected texture)

pixels.description: Explicit pixel list for the pixel operation

plugin.name: parent_object
plugin.title: Reparent node
plugin.description: Move an existing node under a different group, or to the outliner root when `parent` is omitted.

reference.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

parent.description: Parent group; omit to place at the outliner root.

plugin.name: redo
plugin.title: Redo
plugin.description: Step the project forward one or more undo entries.

plugin.name: rollback
plugin.title: Rollback
plugin.description: Restore the project to a checkpoint. Prefers rewinding the undo stack, which is exact and instant; falls back to reloading the stored snapshot when the history has been trimmed. Always re-reads the resulting project and reports whether the rollback verified.

checkpoint_id.description: Checkpoint id, or "last" for the most recent one

plugin.name: run_script
plugin.title: Run script
plugin.description: Execute a JavaScript snippet inside Blockbench with the verified globals in scope and return its JSON value. This is a last resort for things the tool registry cannot express; prefer the dedicated tools. Disabled by default and always requires confirm: true, plus a checkpoint is taken first.

code.description: JavaScript body. Use `return <value>` to produce a result.

confirm.description: Acknowledge that this executes arbitrary code

make_undoable.description: Bracket the script in a single undo entry

plugin.name: save_project
plugin.title: Save project
plugin.description: Compile the whole project to a .bbmodel document and hand it back to the bridge, which writes it next to the active project file. No dialog is shown. Call mark_project_saved afterwards once the file is on disk.
plugin.returns: { model, name, extension, save_path, counts, bytes }

plugin.name: save_project_as
plugin.title: Save project as
plugin.description: Open Blockbench's native export dialog so the user chooses where to write the project. This is interactive and does not return a path; use save_project for headless saving.

plugin.name: select_animation
plugin.title: Select animation
plugin.description: Make an animation the active one, which is required for timeline and keyframe operations to apply to it.

plugin.name: select_object
plugin.title: Select objects
plugin.description: Change the outliner selection. `mode` decides whether the given nodes replace, extend or are removed from the selection. Useful before tools that default to the current selection.

items.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

plugin.name: set_animation_time
plugin.title: Set timeline time
plugin.description: Scrub the playhead to a time and optionally start or stop playback. Use this to inspect a specific pose with get_viewport_image.

plugin.name: set_pivot
plugin.title: Set pivot
plugin.description: Set the rotation pivot of one or more nodes. Accepts explicit coordinates, or an anchor keyword that is resolved against the node bounds: `min`, `center`, `max`, `bottom_center` (the usual pivot for a Minecraft limb), `top_center`, `front_center` and `back_center`.

reference.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

references.description: Set the pivot on several nodes

items.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

pivot.description: Explicit pivot coordinates (three numbers: [x, y, z])

anchor.description: Anchor keyword resolved from the node bounds

offset.description: Offset added to the resolved pivot (three numbers: [x, y, z])

plugin.name: set_project_settings
plugin.title: Set project settings
plugin.description: Change project level settings: name, texture resolution, box UV mode. Resolution is what UV coordinates are measured against, so set it before laying out textures.

box_uv.description: Use box UV for the whole project

plugin.name: set_uv
plugin.title: Set UV
plugin.description: Set per-face UV rectangles on a cube. Each face needs a four number rectangle [u1, v1, u2, v2] in texture pixels. Also accepts cube level settings: uv_offset (box UV origin), rotation, autouv mode and box_uv. Set autouv to 0 when you want your explicit UVs to survive.

faces.description: Per-face UV rectangles keyed by face name

north.description: north UV as [u1, v1, u2, v2]

east.description: east UV as [u1, v1, u2, v2]

south.description: south UV as [u1, v1, u2, v2]

west.description: west UV as [u1, v1, u2, v2]

up.description: up UV as [u1, v1, u2, v2]

down.description: down UV as [u1, v1, u2, v2]

uv_rotation.description: Optional per-face UV rotation in degrees

uv_offset.description: Box UV offset on the texture (two numbers: [u, v])

autouv.description: Auto UV mode: 0 off, 1 auto, 2 relative

plugin.name: set_visibility
plugin.title: Set visibility
plugin.description: Show or hide one or more nodes without deleting them.

reference.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

items.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

visible.description: True to show, false to hide

plugin.name: transaction_abort
plugin.title: Abort transaction
plugin.description: Close the open undo bracket and revert everything that happened inside it. This is the clean way to back out of a failed build phase.

plugin.name: transaction_begin
plugin.title: Begin transaction
plugin.description: Open an undo bracket so every following agent tool call collapses into ONE undo step. Use it to wrap a whole build phase (for example "create the entire T-Rex skeleton") so the user can undo it with a single Ctrl+Z.

label.description: Undo label shown in Blockbench history

plugin.name: transaction_commit
plugin.title: Commit transaction
plugin.description: Close the open undo bracket and record it as a single undo entry.

plugin.name: undo
plugin.title: Undo
plugin.description: Step the project back one undo entry, optionally several times. Returns the undo stack position before and after.

plugin.name: unparent_object
plugin.title: Unparent node
plugin.description: Detach one or more nodes from their parent and move them to the outliner root.

reference.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

items.description: Node reference; omit to use the current selection.

plugin.name: validate_model
plugin.title: Validate model
plugin.description: Self-check the project and return concrete defects with severity: zero or negative size cubes, duplicate names, elements without textures, UV rectangles outside the texture, empty groups, animations without keyframes, missing pivots and unreferenced textures. Run this after building and before saving.

max_issues.description: Cap the number of reported issues

plugin.returns: { issues: [{severity, code, message, node?}], summary, ok }

bridge.name: bridge_look
bridge.title: Look at the model
bridge.description: Render the model from several camera angles and return them as ONE contact sheet image. This is the primary way to see what you have built. The result lists each angle with its pixel region in the sheet. Use it after every meaningful batch of edits, and always before claiming a model looks right.

angles.description: Camera presets to include (default: the standard five-angle set)

annotation.description: What you are checking, e.g. "silhouette after adding the tail"

bridge.returns: { data_url, width, height, cells[], missing[], saved_to }

bridge.name: bridge_generate_texture
bridge.title: Generate a texture
bridge.description: Generate a pixel-art texture procedurally and return it as a PNG data URL ready for create_texture or import_texture. Use this for organic, repetitive parts of a skin (scale patterns, dithered shading, scattered spots, stripes). Use paint_texture inside Blockbench for deliberate details such as eyes, teeth and claws. Deterministic: the same seed regenerates the same texture. The result includes the colour histogram so you can judge contrast.

seed.description: Random seed (reuse to reproduce a texture)

border.description: Colour for a 1px border that hides cube seams, e.g. "#2b2b2b"

split_at.description: Fraction of the height where split_color starts (0-1)

also_create.description: Create the texture inside Blockbench immediately as well

bridge.returns: { name, width, height, data_url, palette, histogram, seed, saved_to, created_in_blockbench }

bridge.name: bridge_save
bridge.title: Save the project
bridge.description: Compile the project and actually write the .bbmodel to disk, then clear the unsaved marker in Blockbench. Use this rather than the plugin's save_project: the plugin can only compile the document (it has no filesystem access), so the file is written here, next to the project's existing path when there is one and into the workspace otherwise.

file_name.description: Override the file name, without extension

directory.description: Absolute directory to write into (defaults to the project path or the workspace)

bridge.name: bridge_checkpoint
bridge.title: Create checkpoint
bridge.description: Record a restorable checkpoint of the current project (geometry, hierarchy, UVs, textures and animations). Call this before a large restructure so you can roll back instead of repairing. Blockbench also checkpoints automatically before destructive tools.

label.description: Short description of the state, e.g. "before adding the tail"

bridge.name: bridge_rollback
bridge.title: Roll back
bridge.description: Restore a checkpoint by id. Use it when a change went badly wrong; it is cheaper and safer than trying to undo a large restructure by hand. Calling it with no id restores the most recent checkpoint.

bridge.name: bridge_remember
bridge.title: Remember
bridge.description: Persist project context so a future run does not have to rediscover it: the goal, the target format, the scale convention, a design decision with its rationale, a note, or a known issue. Use it whenever you make a judgement call the user would want explained later.

known_issue.description: Something wrong that is known and accepted

topic.description: What the decision is about, e.g. "leg length"

source.description: Where the evidence came from, e.g. "reference 2"

bridge.name: bridge_plan
bridge.title: Plan tasks
bridge.description: Write down the subtasks of a long build so progress survives the end of the run and so you can check yourself against the plan. Call it once after OBSERVE, then keep it current with plan_update.

bridge.name: bridge_plan_update
bridge.title: Update a plan step
bridge.description: Mark a subtask done or failed and attach what you learned. Keep the plan honest: a step is only "done" once you have inspected the result.

id.description: Task id, if you have it

note.description: What happened, e.g. "tail pivots were 2px off, fixed"

bridge.name: bridge_references
bridge.title: Re-read the reference images
bridge.description: Re-attach the reference images from ./references to the conversation when you need to re-examine proportions, colours or markings. They are also attached at the start of the task.

names.description: Reference file names to re-read (default: all)

note.description: What you are looking for, e.g. "leg thickness relative to the body"

bridge.name: bridge_finish
bridge.title: Finish the task
bridge.description: End the task and report the result to the user. Call it ONLY after you have inspected the rendered model and, when the task asked for a saved file, saved the project. Set verified true only if you personally confirmed the result with a visual check and validate_model.

summary.description: What you built, what you verified, and anything still weak

verified.description: True only if the final state was inspected and matches the request

saved.description: True if the project was saved

remaining.description: Anything still to do, if the task is not fully complete
